# SmartBiz Fire

SmartBiz Fire provides fire protection and fire safety services for businesses and commercial properties in South Africa, with service coverage focused on Gauteng subject to confirmation.

## Core services

- Fire extinguisher servicing and maintenance
- Fire equipment supply
- Fire safety inspections
- Fire risk assessments
- Fire compliance support
- Fire hose reel servicing
- Fire hydrant servicing
- Safety and compliance documentation
